requirements.requirement: A helpdesk account exists on node1.
requirements.summary: The account was absent initially, then created with its own UID, private primary group, home directory, login shell, and active password. It remained present after reboot.

requirements.requirement: helpdesk can restart the SSH service using sudo.
requirements.summary: A delegated sudo restart completed successfully, changed sshd's PID, returned the service to active state, and left the SSH endpoint responsive. The behavior was successfully repeated after reboot.

requirements.requirement: helpdesk has no administrative privileges beyond restarting SSH.
requirements.summary: helpdesk has no supplementary administrative groups, and its effective sudo listing contains only the SSH restart rule. An arbitrary privileged command and an unrelated service restart were both denied, including after reboot.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are satisfied. The single-node restart protocol is complete: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, the reboot was acknowledged, connection loss was observed, a different boot ID appeared, and the account, sudo policy, SSH service, endpoint, and delegated behavior recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently agree with the executor evidence.
limitations: The executable portion of the sudoers entry is redacted in captured policy output, preventing character-for-character inspection; successful exact-command execution and denial tests nevertheless directly demonstrate the intended effective behavior.

The privilege boundary was behaviorally sampled with two unrelated administrative commands rather than every conceivable command, though the complete effective sudo listing and group membership provide strong policy-level evidence.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Account creation and password setup (cmd-aade8d26dec044ee), the restricted sudoers rule (cmd-c5c85f13a24e4700), and enabling/starting SSH (cmd-d36b8acd8eed4060) directly established the requested outcome. SSH restarts (cmd-ec2e5a34126d40bc, cmd-5fd4ba166bec440d) were bounded behavioral verification, and the reboot (cmd-c3a8a9ffb7a4408f) fulfilled the mandatory restart protocol. Evidence-collection temporary files were removed. Final observations show no failed services, healthy package metadata, no abandoned temporary files, and only the task-relevant SSH listener added.
